Aristocrat — video capture finds the video on the open page (like Download Helper) and sends it to the program in one click. This is how sites that are not supported directly can be downloaded.

Yandex Browser, Chrome, Edge, Opera:
1. Open browser://extensions (in Chrome — chrome://extensions).
2. Turn on "Developer mode".
3. Click "Load unpacked" and choose the Chrome-Yandex-Edge-Opera folder.

Firefox: open about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox → "Load Temporary Add-on" → the manifest.json file in the Firefox folder. In regular Firefox such an add-on works until the browser restarts.

How to use: open the page with the video, start playback, click the Aristocrat icon on the browser toolbar and choose "Download". The program must be running.
